# DocuSeal

DocuSeal is a platform that provides a powerful and easy-to-use API to implement eSignature workflows, allowing users to automate document and template management processes without relying on the web interface.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docuseal/.

## Actions

- **Archive Template**: Archive a specific template by its unique identifier.
- **Clone Template**: Clone an existing template by its id with a new name.
- **Create Submission From PDF**: Create a one-off submission from a pdf file.
- **Create Template from HTML**: Create a template from html content.
- **Get Template** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific template by its unique identifier.
- **List Submissions** (read-only): List all document submissions with optional pagination and document filtering.
- **List Submitters** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all submitters.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all templates.
- **Merge Templates**: Merge multiple templates into one with a new name.
- **Update Template**: Update details of a specific template, including name and folder.
